unresolved.reason: No current British Virgin Islands or Seychelles primary source directly maps an ordinary Seychellois passport to a short-visitor status and actual issuance timing. The current 2026 BVI exemption-order register is not treated as a schedule by omission, and UK treatment is not transferred.

No current official source establishes one Palestine-wide ordinary Seychellois visitor status. Israeli-controlled crossings, permits, recognition, territory-specific access and operational conditions are not flattened into a nationality baseline.
